title: Mixed Event — Play That Beautiful Sound! — Episode5 Let's Try Together!

meta.Event Outline: Having surpassed RAD WEEKEND, life has been quiet for Toya. Just when he feels like trying something new, the owner of an instrument store who he owes a lot to asks him to deal with customers at an event!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you for coming to visit us.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Way to go, Toya!
You're getting really good at this!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I think I've got the hang of things now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm glad to hear that!
Let's keep doing our best until the end!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, let's keep up the good work.
Sorry, are you free to help right now?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thank you for your patience!
How can we help you today? Wait, huh?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
And you're Shiraishi and Aoyagi, yes?
What are the odds of us running into each other here?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know, right?! It's been so long! The last time we spoke was during Shibuya Festa, I think!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Are you two here to look at instruments today?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, so... Originally, we came to see this convention to see the concert.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
But one thing led to another...
And we came here to see if we can help this boy learn to play the trumpet better.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Do you like playing the trumpet?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Y-Yes.
But I'm having trouble playing it properly...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: The two nice ladies said that someone here might be able to help me with that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... Still, what should we do?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, the manager's the one who really knows how to teach people to play, but he's busy with another customer at the moment.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And the convention is going to end soon, so I'm worried that we won't be able to help you in time...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Then, it's okay.
I'm sorry for bothering you.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Thank you all for trying.
I'll go back to my class now...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If keeping a steady tone would be enough, I may be able to teach you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't actually know how to play the trumpet, but I did manage to produce a proper tone with one just the other day.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
So, I may be able to teach you how to do that.
What do you say?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Yes, please teach me!
I want to learn how to play more properly!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. In that case, let's get you set up right away!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Just gimme a second to go grab you a chair!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Alright, to start...
Could you try playing the way you usually do?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But it's definitely not a pretty one.)

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: No matter how hard I try, this always ends up happening. My trumpet sounds thin, or off in some way...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: First, we'll need to check to see if you're buzzing your lips properly.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes.
The most fundamental part of playing the trumpet involves buzzing your lips while blowing into it.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Wow!
That sounds so much better...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's the basic mechanism for producing a good sound.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Way to go, Toya! Look at you!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: My teacher also told me about how using my lips properly is really important...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: But I still can't do it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Then...
Why don't we take a moment to practice playing with just the mouthpiece?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. From what I understand, learning how to consistently produce a steady tone using just the mouthpiece should translate over to producing a good sound with the whole trumpet.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
This is a lot to process.
Just “buzzing your lips properly” seems so complicated...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yoisaki, Asahina!
Would you two also like to give it a try?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes! Why not? Also, I'm sure he'll really appreciate you trying with him!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You're right. It does sound better than sitting here and just watching.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, let's give it a try.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay!
Now, other customers are trying out the trumpets at the moment, so we'll have you use these mouthpieces for the time being!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Actually, I've never tried doing this before either, so mind if I join you two?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
Then, let's try doing what Toya just said. Purse your lips and...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
You're right...
This is more difficult than I realized.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think, when you blow air between your lips, if you buzz them like this...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I heard a faint sound!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wow...!
That's incredible, Asahina! How did you do that?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I thought you two might've been closing your lips too tight, which limits the amount of air that gets through. So, I tried relaxing my lips a little.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh...!
I got it to make a small peep!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: H-Huh...? Th-There's no sound coming out... Let me try again...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
...!
Am I not buzzing my lips enough? Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wh-What am I doing different from those two?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
...
I still can't get it to sound right...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Don't worry. Just take your time and keep trying.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You may want to change the way you use your lips a little. Try to push them out a little; that may make it easier to buzz them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Try to keep air from building in the bottom of your cheeks. Keep your jaw level while relaxing your lips...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Push my lips out slightly... Keep my jaw level...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It is difficult unless you've figured out the trick as to how...

rows.Speaker: Announcement
rows.Line: <Thank you all very much for visiting today's convention.>

rows.Speaker: Announcement
rows.Line: <Unfortunately, we have reached the final thirty minutes of this event. We ask that all customers finish making their selections as soon as possible.>
